_doc: Catalogue of interactive figures. Authors write ':::widget <type>' with 'key: value' lines. Every type also accepts title and caption.

plot.title: Function plotter
plot.desc: Graphs of one or more functions of x, with optional sliders, shading and a draggable tangent.
plot.zh_desc: 一个或多个关于 x 的函数图像，可加滑块、阴影和可拖动的切线。
plot.example:
f: sin(a*x)
sliders: a=1:0.2:3
x: -2pi, 2pi
piticks: true

parametric.title: Parametric curves
parametric.desc: A curve (fx(t), fy(t)) traced by a moving point, with its velocity vector.
parametric.zh_desc: 动点描绘的参数曲线 (fx(t), fy(t))，并显示速度矢量。

oscillator.title: Mass–spring oscillator
oscillator.desc: The driven damped oscillator m x'' + c x' + k x = F cos(ωt), with the resonance curve.
oscillator.zh_desc: 受驱阻尼振子 m x'' + c x' + k x = F cos(ωt)，并给出共振曲线。

slopefield.title: Slope fields
slopefield.desc: Direction field of y' = f(x, y). Click to grow a solution curve.
slopefield.zh_desc: y' = f(x, y) 的方向场。点击即可长出一条解曲线。

vector.title: Vectors in the plane
vector.desc: Drag the tips of two vectors to see their sum, dot product, cross product and the angle between them.
vector.zh_desc: 拖动两个向量的端点，查看它们的和、点积、叉积以及夹角。

motion.title: Constant acceleration
motion.desc: Position against time for motion with constant acceleration. Play it, and change the initial conditions.
motion.zh_desc: 匀加速运动的位置–时间图。可以播放，并改变初始条件。

projectile.title: Projectile
projectile.desc: A projectile launched at speed v and angle θ, with its range, maximum height and time of flight.
projectile.zh_desc: 以速率 v、角度 θ 抛出的物体，并显示射程、最大高度和飞行时间。

incline.title: Block on an incline
incline.desc: Whether a block sticks or slides, and its acceleration, as the angle and the coefficient of friction change.
incline.zh_desc: 改变倾角和摩擦系数，观察物块是静止还是滑动，以及加速度的大小。

springenergy.title: Energy of a spring
springenergy.desc: Kinetic energy, potential energy and their constant sum for a mass on a spring.
springenergy.zh_desc: 弹簧振子的动能、势能以及二者不变的总和。

collision.title: One-dimensional collision
collision.desc: Final velocities of two blocks, from elastic (e = 1) to perfectly inelastic (e = 0).
collision.zh_desc: 两个物块碰撞后的速度，从弹性（e = 1）到完全非弹性（e = 0）。

rolling.title: Rolling race
rolling.desc: A solid sphere, a disc and a hoop roll down the same incline. The one with the smallest I/(mR²) wins.
rolling.zh_desc: 实心球、圆盘和圆环沿同一斜面滚下。I/(mR²) 最小的最先到达。

orbit.title: Orbits
orbit.desc: Trajectory in an inverse-square field. Compare the launch speed with the circular and escape speeds.
orbit.zh_desc: 平方反比力场中的轨迹。把发射速率与圆轨道速率、逃逸速率相比较。

hydro.title: A tank with a hole
hydro.desc: Hydrostatic pressure and Torricelli's speed for a hole a depth d below the surface.
hydro.zh_desc: 液面以下深度 d 处的静压强，以及小孔处的托里拆利速率。

charges.title: Point charges
charges.desc: The electric field of a set of point charges, drawn as a grid of arrows.
charges.zh_desc: 一组点电荷的电场，用箭头网格画出。

charges.desc: q, x, y entries separated by ';'

wave.title: Travelling waves
wave.desc: A wave travelling to the right, plus an optional wave to the left. Equal amplitudes make a standing wave.
wave.zh_desc: 向右传播的波，以及可选的向左的波。振幅相等时形成驻波。

well.title: Infinite square well
well.desc: Energy eigenfunctions and probability densities of the infinite square well, in units ℏ = m = a = 1.
well.zh_desc: 无限深方势阱的能量本征函数和概率密度，单位取 ℏ = m = a = 1。

isotherm.title: Ideal-gas isotherms
isotherm.desc: Three isotherms of an ideal gas, and a point that follows the temperature you choose.
isotherm.zh_desc: 理想气体的三条等温线，以及一个跟随你所设定温度的状态点。

boost.title: Velocity addition
boost.desc: Galilean and Einstein addition of two collinear velocities, and the Lorentz factor of the frame.
boost.zh_desc: 两个共线速度的伽利略叠加与爱因斯坦叠加，以及参考系的洛伦兹因子。
